title: Isn’t As Tailored As Advertised
text:
I’ve decided to quit after two. Here are the pros and cons that pushed me in that direction and a little about the box in general.
There is no theme to the things they put in. There’s a little leaflet where a few “editors” write a blurb about why they like some particular product.
I did receive things I might not have gone out and purchased. They all seem to have a penchant for pre-made masks. And trial sizes. So, on the plus side I was introduced to new things.
The only things I’ve received full size were mascara and eye liner. Everything else was trial or one out of a set.
Prior to starting I answered a bunch of questions meant to “tailor” the products. This last box had something for oily skin (mine is dry) and a brown lip liner (I’m very fair). According to the blurb from the leaflet it came in two colours. The other may have worked.
The final deal breaker was another product that wouldn’t have worked for me and wasn’t sealed. It leaked everywhere. It’s a lot of fun cleaning up tissue-lined paper box.
This months’ package was meant to include two masks according to the leaflet, but had only one.
I really hadn’t expected one this month due to the CV thing going on. If they did go ahead with it I’d have thought they’d have gone above and beyond to make one designed as a sort of pick me up. I don’t hold it against them that they didn’t, but did that they did such a poor job.
The missing, the leaking and wrong stuff does bother me. Also, I’m really not at all sure the value is there. Trial sizes don’t cost much, even at retail. Most any department store could put together a better selection.
And so, immediately after I’m done here I’ll be unsubscribing.
I hope this is helpful to someone.
